newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Big investors trade Telebras.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Big investors trade Telebras.

text.p: Some of the heaviest options trading Tuesday was in options on Telebras, with a couple of large investors accounting for most of the action, traders said.
Shares of the Brazilian telecommunications company traded in the U.S. closed up 7/8 at 100-7/8 after hitting 102, a new 52-week high.
The Telebras April 110 call traded a total of more than 11,500 contracts. The March 95 call traded about 9,570, the March 100 call traded 8,225 and the March 105 call traded about 3,915.
On the put side, the March 95 put traded 1,010.
Telebras options trade on four of the five options exchanges.
"There's a lot of trade going on," Scott Kilrea at LETCO said, referring to Telebras options.
"It really is two-sided. There are both buyers and sellers," he said, adding that sellers were the major players in the morning and buyers in the afternoon.
He said a couple of large firms have been doing about 90 percent of the trading in Telebras options.
"It's not your standard option stock," he said.
Traders said most of the Telebras business was coming from Brazilian investors.
Kilrea added that volatilities in the Telebras options rose sharply Tuesday as the stock rallied.
"Volatilities were probably up 15 percent between last night's close and this morning," he said. "That was a pretty decent volatility move."
He said volatilities were in the mid-30 region.
